summary: The candidate adds an early EAGLE3 validation guard for ordinary targets without a draft path. The recorded base reproduced the exact Llama duplicate-load and hot_token_id AttributeError on gfx950; the exact candidate rejects both the Llama and Qwen issue commands during argument resolution with a clear ValueError. Explicit drafts, bundled drafts, lowercase normalization, EAGLE, and no-spec boundaries remained valid.

tests.command: focused Python contract probe on base using LlamaForCausalLM, EAGLE3, and no draft path
tests.what_was_measured: The base incorrectly completed argument handling and printed NO_ERROR draft=None.

tests.command: python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path HuggingFaceH4/tiny-random-LlamaForCausalLM --load-format dummy --skip-tokenizer-init --mem-fraction-static 0.2 --max-total-tokens 512 --context-length 128 --cuda-graph-backend-decode disabled --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 --port 30000 (base)
tests.what_was_measured: On gfx950 the base loaded LlamaForCausalLM twice and reproduced AttributeError: LlamaForCausalLM has no attribute hot_token_id.
Raised the intended ValueError during argument resolution before scheduler creation or weight loading.

tests.command: python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --skip-tokenizer-init --mem-fraction-static 0.35 --max-total-tokens 4096 --context-length 1024 --cuda-graph-backend-decode disabled --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 --port 30000 (candidate)
tests.what_was_measured: Resolved the public Qwen configuration and raised the intended early ValueError before scheduler creation or weight loading.
Verified uppercase/lowercase EAGLE3 rejection for ordinary targets, explicit draft acceptance, two bundled-draft architectures, unchanged EAGLE behavior, and no-spec behavior.

gpu_execution.evidence: The failing-before Llama reproduction initialized the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, loaded the target twice, allocated memory pools, and reached the reported hot_token_id AttributeError. Candidate success is an intentional pre-GPU validation exit; no numerical inference claim is made.

remaining_limitations: No compatible target/draft pair was run through speculative decoding, so numerical output and semantic accuracy were not evaluated.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; multi-GPU and multi-node behavior were not tested.
The Qwen candidate check resolved the public configuration but intentionally did not load weights because the new validation exits first.
No native/C++ files changed and the prepared environment specified no native build target, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The candidate's committed raw pytest evidence contains trailing whitespace, causing whole-commit git diff --check findings limited to report log files.
